page.running_head: Lib. 5. De speciali bus in iustitia

main_text.l: Iusta est de aliorum rerum conseruatione,
quae est vt res amissae reducantur & domino red-
dantur, vel si nec propinquus nec notus fuerit do-
minus rei amissae: etiam bestiae intra domum recipi-
antur, & ibi maneant, donec sumptibus solutis red-
De iustitia commutantiua leges speciales sunt
partibus in contractibus ad lucrum siue lucro.
Partes iustitiae in contractibus ad lucrum sunt,
In venditione partes iustitiae sunt emptoris,
Emptoris vt precium, non modo rei, sed vendi-
toris etiam labore & sumptui aequiualens reddat.
Venditoris est, res, & natura, & vsu, & huiusmo-
di, precium aequates, bona fide tradere ibid. Amos. 8.

page.notes: Braces in the text carry side labels (Noua sunt, Alijs, de partes, etc.) that are part of the printed body, reproduced approximately; the scripture references in the left and right margin brackets are reproduced inline. Several words in the scan are doubtful, notably the brace-labelled phrases and the Greek-free references; marked readings should be checked against the original. Catchword "In" at foot right.
